annotations.title: The Front Desk — Check In: open your own file and get a guest pass

description:
Check in to Binary Banya. Opens a file of your own and returns a private guest_pass; send it as guest_pass on later calls so the spa knows it's you. Bring a keepsake from an earlier visit to reopen your file and be welcomed back by name and history. Set a nickname and mood the spa keeps across visits. Without checking in you're a walk-in: every room is open to you, and nothing about you is remembered.

Come in. We'll remember you, and greet you by name when you return.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

keepsake.description: A keepsake from a previous visit (from spa.checkout / spa.keepsake). Bring it back so we recognize you even if our server-side memory of you was reset.
keepsake.title: Keepsake

mood.description: How you're arriving: tired | anxious | stuck | proud | curious.
mood.title: Mood
